name: Start-up residence permit

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a cooperation agreement with an RVO-approved facilitator (mentor) who will guide the business.
requirements.fix_path: Find and agree terms with an RVO-approved facilitator.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an innovative product, service, or working method, supported by a step-by-step business plan.
requirements.fix_path: Develop a business plan demonstrating genuine innovation.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires sufficient means to live, financed by yourself, the facilitator, or a third party.

evidence_required.document: Cooperation agreement with an RVO-approved facilitator

sources.title: Residence permit for foreign startups - Business.gov.nl

notes: Fee €423 confirmed via ind.nl fee schedule. Duration confirmed as 1 year per Business.gov.nl official material — a blog claim of a 2-year term circulating on some tier-3 sites is NOT confirmed on official material as of this verification, flagged explicitly as an unresolved discrepancy rather than silently picking one figure. Deliberately terminal in this dataset (leads_to_pr: false, not renewable in place) — the real path forward is switching to nl_self_employed after year 1. The 'bypass' mechanism is now CONFIRMED at tier-1 level (see nl_self_employed's ind_scoring_system source, added 2026-08-08): a facilitator's written declaration confirming successful counseling earns an automatic 30-point bonus toward the Added Value category on the self-employed points assessment — not a full bypass of the points test, but a meaningful, concrete head start. Related but distinct: an 'essential start-up personnel' residence permit exists with its own 2026 income requirement of €3,122/month (excl. holiday allowance, tier-1 IND) — not encoded as a separate route here since it covers employees joining an existing start-up rather than founders, a scope decision rather than an oversight.
